title: AWS Step Functions Failures by State Machine
app: AWS Step Functions execution events via CloudWatch/EventBridge to the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:states:execution status="FAILED" OR status="TIMED_OUT"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by stateMachineName
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts AWS Step Functions failures grouped by state machine so operators immediately see which specific state machines are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'AWS Step Functions is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest AWS Step Functions failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical state machines.
visualization: Table of state machine by failure count and last failure time.

references.title: AWS Step Functions — Monitoring with CloudWatch

grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of AWS Step Functions are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
